statements.statement: Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) was ordered for the patient
The patient has recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness (R42)
The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks (G45.9)
The patient has known sick sinus syndrome (I49.5)
The monitoring was indicated to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity or conduction abnormalities that may not be captured on standard ambulatory monitoring
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial was based on failure to obtain required precertification or prior authorization before services were rendered
